meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏加一个闪电图标，用绿点或红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行，并提供启动、停止、重启的控制。安装时会编译 Swift 二进制、写 launchd 配置并加载服务。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加菜单栏状态指示时触发；仅限 macOS，且需要已安装 Xcode Command Line Tools（swiftc）。

howto.what_en: Adds a lightning-bolt icon to the macOS menu bar with a green or red dot showing whether NanoClaw is running, plus Start, Stop and Restart controls. Install compiles a Swift binary and loads a launchd service.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. macOS only, and it requires Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc).

say_en.text: Add a NanoClaw status icon to my menu bar
say_en.note: Compiles the binary and loads the service
Runs launchctl list and looks for a PID
